Is this patch enabling this property or this is an existing behaviour? If latter please remove it from commit message.

Done. CapacityMiB is existing bmcweb behavior (MemorySizeInKB >> 10 at memory.hpp:478, untouched by this patch). Removed it from the property list together with ErrorCorrection which is also existing behavior. The commit message now lists only properties newly enabled by this patch: MemoryDeviceType, MemoryType, and Location/PartLocation/LocationType.

See PS6:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87974/6//COMMIT_MSG#19
Do you need to update redfish.md file for this property?

Done. Updated docs/Redfish.md Memory section to list the three new properties: Location/PartLocation/LocationType, MemoryDeviceType, and MemoryType.

See PS6:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87974/6/docs/Redfish.md#1071
Please add the list of all the patches needed to build nvl32-obmc working image.

Done. Expanded the Tested section with the full dependency chain: phosphor-dbus-interfaces 89182 (Item.Memory PDI), dbus-sensors chain 86946 + 87166 + 87975, mctpd configuration 87390, upstream Device Tree, upstream U-Boot.

See PS6:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87974/6//COMMIT_MSG#46

Please choose a meaningful topic category.   The repository is bmcweb and all commits are for it by default.


Please continue for all commits under review.
Done, really thanks for your remind.
could we change it topic also to https://gerrit.openbmc.org/q/topic:%22GPU_MemorySummary_ECC%22, because it makes it easier for us to review, and there are no other patches for this topic.
